stem: The owner of a bakery is giving away free muffins every hour. The equation fx=108-9x gives the number of free muffins, fx, that remain to be given away after x hours. Which of the following is the best interpretation of f12=0 in this context?

answerOptions.content: The owner of the bakery has 12 free muffins to give away.
The owner of the bakery will give away 12 free muffins in 9 hours.
It will take 12 hours to give away all the free muffins.
It will take 108 hours to give away 12 free muffins.

rationale:
Choice C is correct. It’s given that the equation f(x)=108−9x represents the number of free muffins that remain to be given away after x hours. For the given equation f(12)=0, when the value of x is 12, the value of f(x) is 0. It follows that after 12 hours there are 0 free muffins remaining to be given away. Therefore, based on this context, it will take 12 hours to give away all the free muffins.

Choice A is incorrect and may result from conceptual or calculation errors.

Choice B is incorrect and may result from conceptual or calculation errors.

Choice D is incorrect. This represents giving away 12 muffins over 108 hours rather than giving away all 108 muffins in 12 hours.
